insights.topic: Verified purchase proof vs. probabilistic targeting
insights.insight: Crinkl's cryptographically verified receipts confirm purchases happened — not inferred. At ~$0.10 per verified receipt and $75K in GMV across 1,810 receipts in the trailing 7 days, this is a live, scaled alternative to cookie-based inference at a fraction of what probabilistic CPMs cost.

insights.topic: Grocery and retail dominance in verified spend
insights.insight: Walmart (305 receipts), Kroger (148), Safeway (137), and Costco (129) are the durable anchors across 14 days — grocery-supermarkets leads by receipt volume (1,344), while retail-department-stores leads by GMV ($32,818 vs. $57,917 on 616 fewer receipts), confirming a measurably higher average ticket in retail.

Week-over-week token velocity sits below 1x (0.591x), meaning trailing GMV isn't yet self-replacing — but acceleration has hit 1.239x, the highest reading on record and the second consecutive morning above 1.1x. If the pattern holds through UTC close, it marks an inflection in growth rate, not just growth.

insights.topic: Restaurants & Dining threshold crossing confirmed durable
insights.insight: Restaurants & Dining first crossed the aggregate visibility threshold at Nov 04T03:16 and has now held across four consecutive snapshots (972 receipts / $29,439 in 14 days) — this category is no longer provisional and represents a verified dining spend signal for QSR and casual dining brands.

The Unknown category grew from 415 receipts / $20,312 to 504 receipts / $24,469 in a single observation window — a 21% receipt increase. For brands building audience models, unclassified spend at this scale represents either a data-quality risk or an emerging category not yet surfaced in the taxonomy.

insights.topic: DKIM vendor surface spans physical and digital commerce
insights.insight: Verified receipt ingestion now covers both physical retail (Walmart, Kroger, Costco) and digital commerce (Stripe, Paddle, Gumroad, Amazon) via DKIM email verification — giving brands a single verified-spend signal across channels without cookies, panels, or self-reported survey data.
